claim_verdicts.evidence: Core concepts: "Sync status: Whether or not the live state matches the target state." "Target state: The desired state of an application, as represented by files in a Git repository." Execution (gitops-first-sync.txt:3-24): every object OutOfSync while none exists; Synced after the sync (40-60). staging-manual.yaml:16 `targetRevision: main`.

Sync Options: "By default, Argo CD executes the `kubectl apply` operation to apply the configuration stored in Git." Core concepts: "Sync: The process of making an application move to its target state. E.g. by applying changes to a Kubernetes cluster."

Automated Sync Policy: "Argo CD has the ability to automatically sync an application when it detects differences"; enabled by "a syncPolicy with an `automated` policy". FAQ: "If there are any Git changes, Argo CD will only update applications with the auto-sync setting enabled." staging-manual.yaml has no syncPolicy (lines 12-20). Round 2 §3 wording "a setting in the Application that tells Argo CD to sync on its own when it finds a difference" fits.

Health page: "`Progressing` - the resource is not healthy yet but still making progress and might be healthy soon"; Deployment: "Observed generation is equal to desired generation." "Number of updated replicas equals the number of desired replicas." Docs omit availability; execution settles it: Progressing at READY 0/2, UP-TO-DATE 2, AVAILABLE 0; Healthy at AVAILABLE 2 (txt:29-38).

Health page: "The App health will be the worst health of its immediate child sources." "The priority of most to least healthy statuses is: `Healthy`, `Suspended`, `Progressing`, `Missing`, `Degraded`, `Unknown`." Round 2 §4 sentence "keeps the Application from `Healthy`" now claims only what this supports.

Health page lists `Missing` only in the priority order, with no definition. Execution: with no object of envs/staging in donhang, app_wait prints "staging: OutOfSync, Missing" (txt:3); the App takes the worst child health and only absent objects exist, so Missing is what those objects report. Per-object health column is empty in status.resources (txt:5-24), so the object-level value is inferred, not printed.

Resource tracking: "`annotation` (default) - Argo CD uses the `argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id` annotation to track application resources." Sync options: "The app will be out of sync if Argo CD expects a resource to be pruned." gitops-self-heal.txt:5-8: "ConfigMap/prune-demo: requiresPruning=true". Namespace not in status.resources: "no" (gitops-first-sync.txt, last line). Round 3: "created by OpenTofu" holds: deploy/tofu/modules/donhang-platform/main.tf:17-19 `kubernetes_namespace_v1` name "donhang".

FAQ: "The default maximum polling interval is 3 minutes (120 seconds + 60 seconds jitter)." Annotations: argocd.argoproj.io/refresh, `normal`, `hard`: "Indicates that app needs to be refreshed. Removed by application controller after app is refreshed." Core concepts: "Refresh: Compare the latest code in Git with the live state." gitops.sh:106 sets refresh=normal. Lesson states no interval value.

Sync with kubectl: example patch `operation: initiatedBy: username: <username>` then `sync:`; "You can pass optional information like "info" or "initiatedBy"." The page describes initiatedBy as information about who initiated the operation request (seen as summary). Sync state is reported in "operationState", example `phase: Succeeded`. `sync.revision` not in the doc example; execution settles it: script :31-38, output "sync: Succeeded" (txt:26-28).

gitops-first-sync.txt: 1-3 header, apply, "staging: OutOfSync, Missing"; 5-24 all OutOfSync; 28 "sync: Succeeded"; 29-32 Synced/Progressing, api 0/2; 34-38 Synced/Healthy, api 2/2; 62-63 "no". The lesson's output block reproduces these lines with `...` elisions.

Argo CD Health page: Deployment checks are on observed generation and updated replicas, fields of the Deployment's status; no probe call described. Kubernetes Deployment: minReadySeconds "defaults to 0 (the Pod will be considered available as soon as it is ready)". Execution: Progressing at AVAILABLE 0, Healthy at AVAILABLE 2 (txt:29-38); readiness probe at api.yaml:61-64.

DonHang.Api/Program.cs:123-124 `AddHealthChecks().AddDbContextCheck<DonHangDbContext>(tags: ["ready"])`; :225 `MapHealthChecks("/health/ready", ... Predicate = check => check.Tags.Contains("ready"))`; :223 "/health/ready runs the \"ready\" checks: the database." No DB -> readiness fails -> Pod never available -> by claims 5 and 11 not Healthy, while sync status stays Synced.

git show stage-3:scripts/devops/gitops-first-sync.sh: :15 `echo "== the Application, from deploy/gitops/lessons/staging-manual.yaml"`, :16 `kubectl apply -f deploy/gitops/lessons/staging-manual.yaml -o name` = output lines 1-2; :6 `source scripts/lib/gitops.sh`; :22 `app_wait OutOfSync Missing "" 120`. gitops.sh:105-107 app_refresh annotates refresh=normal; :113 `revision=${3:-} seconds=${4:-600}`; :119 empty revision matches any commit.

First run: txt:3, 28-38, 63. Re-run: with staging Synced/Healthy, script :22 `app_wait OutOfSync Missing "" 120` cannot match; gitops.sh:125 prints "$app is still $sync, $health after $seconds s (wanted ...)" and returns 1; `set -euo pipefail` (:4) ends the script. Quoted prefix matches. Round 3 (targeted: §4 namespace paragraph, §6 misconception 3, q5 en/vi, claim 7) opened: lesson §4/§6, quiz q5, meta claim 7, deploy/tofu/modules/donhang-platform/main.tf.

issues.text: Carried from round 2 (originally round 1). The first run of step 2 takes longer than the 3 minutes in the heading, which the lesson admits. It doesn't stop me, since Expected result is concrete and it warns that the script stays quiet while it waits, but the heading promises something the first run can't keep.
issues.quote: The first sync can take several minutes beyond the 3 in the heading while images download
issues.fix: Keep the warning, and say roughly how long the first run takes on a fresh cluster (e.g. 'up to N minutes') so I know when to start worrying.
